xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5475: docs: costs and spend

narratives.Problem: Overdeck has no user page about cost. Facts are scattered across cli/core-commands.mdx, features/dashboard-views.mdx, features/mission-control.mdx, configuration/linked-machines.mdx and a token spend report with a v0.21.0 screenshot. Planning also found that pan cost today/week/month/report and budgets always report zero, and that two Costs page cards and the Project Home Spend link do not work (filed as #5562).
narratives.Proposal: Add features/costs.mdx with sections on how cost is counted, API prices versus plan bills, attribution (issues, conversations, Flywheel, unattributed, project spend and windows), where spend shows in the dashboard, the experimental Costs page, pan cost from the terminal, opt-in cost limits, and getting help, every fact taken from code per PRD facts F-1 to F-32. Document only working behavior and link #5562 where a command or card reports nothing. Add the page to docs.json after dashboard-views, add one link sentence in five related pages, and validate with mint@4.3.49 and lint:docs.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No code change: the dead pan cost subcommands, budgets, Costs page cards and Spend link (#5562) and mis-priced models (#4844) are fixed in their own issues
- No screenshots and no change to images/ (the existing costs screenshots are from v0.21.0)
- No API route reference, token spend report regeneration steps, cockpit CostCard, Resources burn rate or model picker cost badges
- No recommendation to create budgets or use pan cost today/week/month/report while #5562 is open
- No sentence changes in the five linking pages beyond one added sentence or link each
- No changelog.d entry
- No claim that Overdeck knows plan or subscription costs

autoDecisions.summary: One new page features/costs.mdx placed right after features/dashboard-views in the Features group
autoDecisions.rationale: The Costs page is one of the dashboard views, and the issue names features/costs.mdx as the page.

autoDecisions.summary: Document only working behavior and name each broken cost surface once with a link to #5562
autoDecisions.rationale: Same pattern as the merged desktop-app page (#5556); readers should not follow instructions for budgets or daily summaries that always print zero.

autoDecisions.summary: Answer 'API-rate vs plan costs' as: every figure is tokens times published API prices, so it is an API-price equivalent, and no view shows plan cost
autoDecisions.rationale: No code writes the subscription-covered marker; the only accurate statement is that Overdeck does not know what a plan covers.

autoDecisions.summary: Cover pan cost report, sync and backfill briefly in addition to the six subcommands the issue names
autoDecisions.rationale: They appear in pan cost --help; one line each keeps the page complete without describing unverified multi-developer sync.

autoDecisions.summary: Linking pages get one additive sentence or link each, including a #5562 caveat in cli/core-commands.mdx and features/mission-control.mdx
autoDecisions.rationale: Those pages currently present broken commands and a gated click as working; the per-page accuracy audits own any rewrite.
